Title: Café 181
Description:

Title: Book Club: Inaugural Meeting
Description: The first meeting of the 181 Fremont book club. We’re beginning with London Falling: A Mysterious Death in a Gilded City and a Family’s Search for Truth by Patrick Radden Keefe. Please join us whether or not you’ve finished it. This first evening is as much about finding the group’s rhythm as it is about the book. Light bites and wine will be served. From September we’ll settle into the last Wednesday of each month at 4:30.

Title: A Night in Mexico City
Description:
The marquee evening of our season. A tribute to Michelin-level, Latin-inspired cooking, drawing on the techniques of Californios here in San Francisco and the celebrated kitchens of Mexico City.

Twelve seats at one table on Level 39, with the city forty floors below. Courses are served family-style where the food calls for it, and plated where it doesn’t. Each one is built around a single idea carried from a particular kitchen.

$75 per person. Seats are released on a first-come basis, and we expect this one to fill quickly.

Title: Succulent Pumpkin Workshop
Description:
A succulent-topped pumpkin to carry your home through the autumn. You’ll design your own, and learn how to keep the cuttings healthy along the way.

We begin with a demonstration and a proper talk on succulent care, then everyone builds theirs. Mini pumpkins and all materials are provided, so there’s nothing to bring.

When the pumpkin has had its run, often many months from now, the cuttings can be replanted and enjoyed for years. Light bites and wine will be served throughout.

Title: Kokedama
Description:
The Japanese art of moss ball gardening. You’ll wrap a living plant in nutrient-rich soil and soft moss to make a kokedama, a sculptural piece that sits on a shelf or hangs by a window.

We begin with a demonstration, then everyone makes their own. All supplies and care instructions are provided, and no experience is needed.

Light bites and wine will be served throughout. You’ll take home your kokedama, and everything you need to keep it thriving.
